summary: The supplied source shows two causes: EncodeUTF8Char returns lengths one byte too small for three- and four-byte encodings, so CUnescape truncates decoded Unicode; IsSurrogate checks only the low-surrogate range, so U+D835 is accepted. The evidence is sufficient to target both defects directly.
hypotheses: EncodeUTF8Char returns incorrect lengths for three- and four-byte UTF-8 encodings.
IsSurrogate rejects low surrogates but accepts high surrogates.
